definitions.explanation: A major Japanese electronics company based in Osaka Prefecture, making household appliances, batteries, housing equipment and industrial products. Founded in 1918 by Matsushita Kōnosuke and known as Matsushita Electric until 2008.

examples.japanese: パナソニック⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧パナソニック⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
パナソニック⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{松下電器|まつしたでんき}⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧だった。
examples.english: Panasonic used to be a company called Matsushita Electric.

notes:
One of the best-known Japanese makers of home appliances (⟦{家電|かでん}→家電：04966_kaden⟧), from rice cookers and washing machines to hair dryers and batteries.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Its founder, {松下幸之助|まつしたこうのすけ}, is a famous figure in Japanese business, often called the "god of management" (⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{神様|かみさま}→神様：00161_kamisama⟧). Older people may still call the company {松下|まつした} or by its former brand name ナショナル.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- パナソニック⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧: made by Panasonic
- パナソニック⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家電|かでん}→家電：04966_kaden⟧: Panasonic home appliances
